questions.title: Add 12 pt Space Before Paragraph to the First Paragraph and make it Italic.
questions.instruction: Add 12 pt Space Before Paragraph to the First Paragraph and make it Italic.
tasks: Add 12 pt Space Before Paragraph to the First Paragraph and make it Italic.
questions.source_content:
GAZETTE NOTIFICATION
Directorate of Treasuries & Accounts, Barmer
Date: 8 March 2025 (Ref No: RAJ/215)
Subject: Modernization of Agricultural Mandis and Online Commodity Assaying Facilities (Phase-4)
All concerned branch officers and ministerial staff of Barmer division are hereby informed that under 'Modernization of Agricultural Mandis and Online Commodity Assaying Facilities', a comprehensive verification drive will be conducted on 13 March in the central pending wing. Every section head must submit the verified statement (Code #315) on time.
During the recent quarterly review at Barmer, it was observed that certain units have not updated their daily dispatch schedules and pending movement logs. Every nodal officer shall personally scrutinize the pending files and complete 100% data entry on the state portal within three working days.
Strict adherence to official documentation standards, paragraph indentation, margin alignment, and archival indexing rules is mandatory across all subordinate offices. Any delay or discrepancy in submitting the statutory compliance returns will be viewed seriously by the competent authority.
Key Action Points: 1. File Audit (Barmer), 2. Budget Reconciliation #125, 3. Digital Indexing.
Additional District Collector
Kavita Khandelwal
solution_steps: 1. Click inside the First Paragraph.
2. Set Spacing Before to '12 pt' and click Italic.
